Basic and donor-rich aromatic probes target broad predicted regions supported by severe measured errors, while m125, m28, m81, m107, m39, m167, m198, m114, m72, and m92 add endpoint-focused condition contrasts. Several selections vary ratio, loading amount, loading-solvent volume, or solvent system around related scaffolds so retraining can learn non-smooth V1/V2 interactions. The m29 point continues a discriminating onset curve. Hydrophobic, halogen, nitrile, oxygenated, and compact m140/m157 controls constrain transfer of polar-family corrections. This combination should improve generalization by repairing recurring failure neighborhoods while teaching the model where broad predictions collapse into compact elution."}
